title: Ordinary Differential Equations
subject: Differential Equations
summary: First-order methods, linear second-order equations with constant coefficients (oscillators, damping, resonance), Laplace transforms and impulse response, linear systems via eigenvalues, phase portraits and linearisation, series solutions, and numerical methods. Built on MIT 18.03 lectures and Boas ch. 8, with the chemist's rate equations, damped vibrations and oscillating reactions as recurring examples.

units.title: First-Order Equations
units.summary: Separable and linear first-order ODEs, direction fields, autonomous equations and stability: the mathematics of first-order kinetics and relaxation.

lessons.title: ODEs, Solutions and Direction Fields
objectives: Classify an ODE by order, linearity and homogeneity, and state what a general solution and an initial-value problem are.
Sketch a direction field for y' = f(x, y) and use it to predict the qualitative shape of solutions.
